question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

John was always ________ about becoming a millionaire without doing any hard work.

options.text: a storm in a tea cup
having an ace up his sleeve

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom 'building castles in the air' means indulging in daydreams or fantasies that are unlikely to come true.
 
• In the given sentence, **John dreams of becoming a millionaire without any hard work, which is an impractical and unrealistic goal.**
 
• Therefore, the most **appropriate idiom **to fill in the blank is 'building castles in the air'.

Hence, the correct sentence is "***John was always building castles in the air__ about becoming a millionaire without doing any hard work."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Other idioms that could be confused in this context:
 
 
• **A storm in a teacup:** Refers to a small event that has been exaggerated out of proportion.
 
• **Eating like a horse:** Means eating a lot of food.
 
• **Having an ace up his sleeve:** Means having a secret advantage or strategy.
 
 
 
• None of these idioms fit the context of John dreaming unrealistically about becoming a millionaire without hard work.
